title: Effects of the Eighth House (Randhra Bhava Phala)
verification_note: PDF-first audit from Santhanam Vol 1 pp.169-172. Previous audit (S312) only covered v.1-7 (sloka_count=7). This re-audit covers all 15 slokas. 9 slokas (v.8-13, v.14-15) were entirely missing — all short-life combinations and late long-life yogas. Also found under-encoding in v.3 and v.4-7.

claims.claim: 8th lord in an angle → long life indicated
8th lord in 8th conjunct a malefic → short-lived
8th lord in 8th conjunct ascendant lord → short-lived (alternative path)
Saturn joins malefic or ascendant lord in 8th house → short life (per Santhanam note: apply v.2 logic to Saturn)
claims.note: Current BPHS1903 only has Saturn in house 8, missing the conjunction requirement with malefic/ascendant lord. Fix during encoding.

claims.claim: 10th lord in 8th with malefic or ascendant lord → short life (Santhanam note expands v.3)
claims.note: Currently only in modifier text of BPHS1903, not a proper separate rule

claims.claim: 6th and 12th lords simultaneously in 6th and 12th → long life (yoga 2 from Santhanam note)
claims.note: In BPHS1904 description but not encoded as separate condition

claims.claim: 6th lord in ascendant while 12th lord in 8th → long life (yoga 3 from Santhanam note)
claims.note: In BPHS1904 description but not encoded as separate condition

claims.claim: Lords of 5th, 8th, and ascendant in own navamsas/rasis/friendly signs → long span of life
Lords of ascendant, 8th, 10th + Saturn all in angles/trines/11th → long life
claims.note: In BPHS1905 description text but not encoded as separate rule

claims.claim: Life span between 20 and 32 years if ascendant lord is weak while 8th lord is in an angle
Short-lived only if 8th lord is in fall while 8th has a malefic in it and ascendant lord bereft of strength
Death instant at birth if 8th house, 8th lord and 12th house are ALL conjunct malefics
Malefics in angles/trines AND benefics in 6th/8th AND 8th lord in fall in ascendant → immediate death
claims.note: health_sensitive=True, safety_tier=restricted. Three simultaneous conditions required.

claims.claim: 5th house, 8th house and 8th lord all conjunct malefics → life span very brief
8th lord in 8th while Moon conjunct malefics and bereft of benefic aspect → death within a month of birth
claims.note: health_sensitive=True, safety_tier=restricted. Santhanam notes: 8th lord in 8th normally gives long life (v.1 logic), but Moon affliction overrides.

claims.claim: Long-lived if ascendant lord in exaltation while Moon in 11th and Jupiter in 8th from ascendant
Ascendant lord exceedingly strong AND aspected by benefic from angle → wealthy, virtuous, and long-lived
claims.note: Multiple outcome domains: longevity + wealth + character

summary.critical_gaps: v.8-13 (ALL short-life combinations), v.14-15 (long-life yogas). Also v.3 under-specified and v.4-7 missing alternative conditions.
